s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.body: By accessing or using the ADB Exchange platform ("Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you do not agree to these Terms, please do not use the Platform. These Terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and ADB Exchange.

s2.title: 2. Eligibility
s2.intro: To use our Platform, you must:
items: Be at least 18 years old or the legal age of majority in your jurisdiction
Have full legal capacity to enter into binding agreements
Not be a resident of any jurisdiction where cryptocurrency trading is prohibited
Complete our identity verification (KYC) process when required
Not have been previously suspended or removed from the Platform

s3.title: 3. Account Registration and Security
s3.intro: When creating an account, you agree to:
items: Provide accurate and complete information during registration
Maintain and promptly update your account information
Keep your login credentials confidential
Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for enhanced security
Notify us immediately of any unauthorized access to your account
Accept responsibility for all activities that occur under your account

s4.title: 4. Platform Services
s4.intro: ADB Exchange provides the following services:
items: Spot Trading: Buy and sell cryptocurrencies at current market prices
P2P Trading: Trade directly with other users using various payment methods
Wallet Services: Store and manage your digital assets
Deposit & Withdrawal: Transfer funds to and from the Platform

s5.title: 5. Trading Rules and Restrictions
items: Engage in market manipulation, wash trading, or any fraudulent activity
Use the Platform for money laundering or terrorist financing
Circumvent any trading limits or restrictions
Use automated trading systems without prior authorization
Interfere with or disrupt the Platform's infrastructure
Attempt to gain unauthorized access to other users' accounts

s6.title: 6. Fees and Payments
s6.body: ADB Exchange charges fees for certain services, including trading fees, withdrawal fees, and other applicable charges. All fees are clearly displayed before you confirm any transaction. We reserve the right to modify our fee structure with advance notice to users. You are responsible for any taxes applicable to your transactions.

s6a.title: 6A. Regulatory Compliance (PMLA / FIU-IND)
s6a.body: In compliance with the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), 2002 and FIU-IND guidelines, we implement KYC, transaction monitoring, and reporting procedures. You agree to cooperate with identity verification, provide accurate information, and not use the Platform for money laundering, terrorist financing, or other illicit purposes. P2P and other transactions are subject to per-order and daily limits. We may suspend accounts or report suspicious activity as required by law.

s7.title: 7. Compliance & PMLA
s7.body: We comply with applicable anti‑money laundering (AML) and counter‑terrorist financing (CTF) laws, including the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), 2002, as amended. We are registered with FIU‑IND as a reporting entity where required. You agree to provide accurate information for KYC and to cooperate with any regulatory or compliance requests. Large or suspicious transactions may be monitored and reported as per law.
s7.body2: P2P and other services are subject to transaction limits for compliance. Violation of AML/CTF obligations may result in account suspension and reporting to authorities.

s8.title: 8. Risk Disclosure
s8.body: Cryptocurrency trading involves substantial risk of loss and is not suitable for every investor. The value of cryptocurrencies can be extremely volatile. You should carefully consider whether trading is appropriate for you in light of your financial condition. Past performance is not indicative of future results. You acknowledge that you trade at your own risk.

s9.title: 9. Limitation of Liability
s9.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, ADB Exchange shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including but not limited to loss of profits, data, or other intangible losses, resulting from your use of or inability to use the Platform.

s10.title: 10. Intellectual Property
s10.body: All content on the Platform, including but not limited to text, graphics, logos, images, and software, is the property of ADB Exchange or its licensors and is protected by intellectual property laws. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without our prior written consent.

s11.title: 11. Termination
s11.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account at any time for any reason, including violation of these Terms. Upon termination, you must cease all use of the Platform and may be required to withdraw your remaining funds within a specified period.

s12.title: 12. Governing Law
s12.body: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the jurisdiction in which ADB Exchange is incorporated, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.

s13.title: 13. Changes to Terms
s13.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new Terms on the Platform and updating the "Last updated" date. Your continued use of the Platform after such changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.

s14.title: 14. Contact Us
s14.body: If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact us at:
s14.contactBox: Support: use the in-app Help Center (Account → Help). No public email domain is published here.

s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.body: ADB Exchange ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our cryptocurrency trading platform and related services. Please read this policy carefully to understand our practices regarding your personal data.

s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
s2.intro21: We may collect the following personal information:
items21: Full name and date of birth
Financial information, including bank account details
s2.intro22: We automatically collect certain technical data:

s3.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
s3.intro: We use the collected information for:
items: Account Management: Creating, maintaining, and securing your account
Identity Verification: Complying with KYC/AML regulations
Service Provision: Processing transactions and providing platform features
Communication: Sending service updates, security alerts, and promotional materials
Security: Detecting and preventing fraud, unauthorized access, and illegal activities
Legal Compliance: Meeting regulatory requirements and responding to legal requests
Improvement: Analyzing usage patterns to enhance our services

s4.title: 4. Information Sharing
s4.intro: We may share your information with:
items: Service Providers: Third parties who help us operate the platform (payment processors, KYC providers, cloud services)
Legal Authorities: When required by law, subpoena, or court order
Regulatory Bodies: To comply with financial regulations and reporting requirements
Business Partners: For integrated services, with your consent
Corporate Transactions: In connection with mergers, acquisitions, or asset sales
s4.footer: We do not sell your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

s5.title: 5. Data Security
s5.intro: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data:
items: AES-256 encryption for data at rest
TLS 1.3 encryption for data in transit
Multi-factor authentication (MFA)
Regular security audits and penetration testing
Cold storage for the majority of digital assets
24/7 security monitoring and intrusion detection

s6.title: 6. Data Retention
s6.body: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. After account closure, we may retain certain data for legal, regulatory, and legitimate business purposes, typically for a period of 5-7 years, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

s7.title: 7. Your Rights
s7.intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights:
items: Access: Request a copy of your personal data
Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate data
Erasure: Request deletion of your data (subject to legal retention requirements)
Restriction: Request limitation of data processing
Portability: Request transfer of your data to another service
Objection: Object to certain processing activities
Withdraw Consent: Withdraw previously given consent
s7.footer: To exercise these rights, please contact us through the in-app Help Center.

s8.title: 8. Cookies and Tracking
s8.intro: We use cookies and similar technologies to:
items: Remember your login status and preferences
Analyze platform usage and performance
Enhance security and detect suspicious activity
Personalize your experience
s8.footer: You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings, though disabling certain cookies may affect platform functionality.

s9.title: 9. International Data Transfers
s9.body: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for such transfers, including standard contractual clauses and adequacy decisions, to protect your data in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

s10.title: 10. Children's Privacy
s10.body: Our platform is not intended for individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child, we will take steps to delete such information promptly.

s11.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
s11.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on our platform and updating the "Last updated" date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically for any changes.

s12.title: 12. Contact Us
s12.body: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
s12.contactBox: Privacy / support requests: use the in-app Help Center (Account → Help). No public email domain is published here.

s1.title: 1. What Are Cookies
s1.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our platform. They help us provide a better experience for spot trading and P2P transactions.

s2.title: 2. How We Use Cookies
items: Keep you logged in and maintain your session
Remember your preferences (e.g. theme, language)
Improve platform performance and security
Analyze usage to enhance the trading experience

s3.title: 3. Managing Cookies
s3.body: You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect platform functionality, including login and trading features.
